test.create_query: CREATE TABLE join_disj_left (k UInt64, sel UInt64, payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE join_disj_right (k UInt64, x UInt64, payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, auto_statistics_types = ''
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO join_disj_left SELECT number, number % 1000, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> hex(sipHash64(number, i)), range(8)), ' ') FROM numbers(3000000)
INSERT INTO join_disj_right SELECT number, number % 1000, arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> hex(sipHash64(number, i)), range(8)), ' ') FROM numbers(3000000)
test.query: SELECT sum(length(l.payload)) + sum(length(r.payload)) FROM join_disj_left AS l INNER JOIN join_disj_right AS r ON l.k = r.k WHERE (l.sel = 1 AND r.x = 1) OR (l.sel = 2 AND r.x = 2) FORMAT Null
